board: Meghalaya Civil Secretariat Vacancy 2026 - 153 Peon, Chowkidar and More PostsMeghalaya Civil Secretariat Vacancy 2026
title: Post Name
age_limit: Candidates should not be more than 32 years of age and not less than 18 years of age, as on 1 January 2026 . || To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.
application_fee: Fee can be paid through: (a) Debit-cum-ATM Card/Credit Card/Net Banking; (b) UPI; or (c) E-Challan (cash payment) at any branch of the State Bank of India. For cash payment, candidates must select payment across the bank counter, fill in the required details to generate an e-challan, and pay at any SBI branch; the e-challan itself does not need to be submitted separately. An additional amount may apply as the bank's commission.
selection_process: Selection is made by the Departmental Selection Committee, and candidates must appear for a written examination at their own expense. There is no interview, in line with Office Memorandum No.PER(AR)58/2024/36 dated Shillong, 29 July 2025. || Total duration is 1 hour (1 hour 30 minutes for PWD candidates). There is negative marking for wrong answers, with details to be specified in the question paper guidelines. Examination centres are Shillong, Tura, Jowai, Nongstoin, and Nongpoh; once a centre is selected it cannot be changed, and if the number of candidates opting for Jowai, Nongstoin, or Nongpoh is inadequate, the Departmental Selection Committee may direct such candidates to the nearest centre instead. If a single candidate qualifies for more than one Grade IV post category, the Departmental Selection Committee will decide which post they are selected for. || Reservation of vacancies is as per the Reservation Policy of the Government of Meghalaya.
